_about: Which pages get the edit button and how they save (shared/site-editor/README.md). Every HTML page the project server shows gets the button, in layer mode (edits kept in edits/<page>.json and applied over the page), except: 'off' pages get no button; 'source' pages are hand-written, so what their file holds is edited in the file itself; 'alias' sends a copy's edits to its original; 'notes' show in the editor's help. Paths are relative to the project folder; a path ending in / covers the folder.

notes.sites/lumebook-partners/index.html: The partners page in four languages (index.html is Hebrew, en/ ar/ ru/ are the others), built from sites/lumebook-partners/src/content/*.json. Local review copy, not published. Your edits are kept in the edits layer; to change wording for good ask Claude to change the content file and run the lint.
notes.sites/lumebook-smm-plan/index.html: Hebrew changes here need the English mirror in content.en.md before they can be committed: ask Claude to mirror them.
notes.sites/dashboard/lumebook-dashboard.html: HQ: the tools grid has its own edit mode (the עריכה button) for moving, renaming and adding tools. Use this editor for the rest of the page.
notes.creators/creator-research/lumebook-creat: The creator cards come from the map's data: statuses, notes and messages are changed in the map itself. Edits here change how the page looks.
notes.hook-studio/app: Carousel Machine: packs, grades and productions come from its own data. Edits here change how the page looks.
notes.shared/site-editor/test/: Test pages for the edit button (shared/site-editor/README.md). Safe to edit.
